The Dawnbreaker CBT begins on December 3!

The Oathblade once witnessed the Five Great Houses swear their loyalty. But with the Mad King’s fall, their ancient alliance crumbled.

The old generation’s ambition has faded, and a new struggle for power is quietly beginning:

Young Baron Michael is determined to restore the order his family lost, with his old enemy Tonino never far behind.

Empress Ravenscar accepts the new king’s commission and becomes the strongest blade in House Hegney’s ranks.

Wait—what does any of this have to do with me?

You, yes you—the new captain of the Drift Bottle!

Will you cut through the shadows of the past, or set sail with sunshine, sea breeze, and a few friends for a carefree adventure full of mischief?

Digital pre-orders and physical edition pre-orders are now available.

This entry in the Atelier series focuses on tying in alchemy to deepen every aspect of the game. Synthesized items can now be used for more than just combat. They will assist you during exploration and base-building, and will help shape the very path of your adventure. Karia can also eat synthesized items to change both her appearance and abilities. Synthesize items, use them on your adventure, and eat them. This cycle will tie everything together in this new evolution of the Atelier series.
